caption: Flatten only the first level
Depth 2 removes two levels of nesting
An explicit infinite depth flattens every level, like the default
A list of levels regroups the dimensions, here into a transpose
Nested calls of any one head flatten, not just lists
$Flatten$ undoes [[Partition]]: chunking and re-flattening recovers the original list
A list with no nesting is unchanged
Flattening an $m \times n$ matrix gives $mn$ elements. See [[Length]]
